title: Friday IVR
tagline: An AI that answers real phone calls and talks back naturally.
description: An AI-powered telephony platform that handles natural voice conversations over ordinary phone calls. The hardware side uses an ESP32, an ES8388 audio codec and a SIMCom A7670S GSM module; the software side chains speech-to-text, LLM orchestration and text-to-speech, with knowledge-base powered answers.
highlights: GSM and telephony integration on custom hardware
Modular architecture for business use cases

title: DialCast
tagline: A GSM robo-caller that dials out and plays recorded messages.
description: A GSM-based automated calling platform that places outbound calls and delivers pre-recorded audio messages, with campaign execution workflows on top of real modem hardware.

title: Emaily
tagline: AI that sorts your inbox into categories you define.
description: An intelligent email management platform that connects to Gmail and Outlook and uses AI to categorise and organise email automatically into user-defined categories.

title: Microsoft Graph Middleware
tagline: Production middleware replacing legacy Exchange EWS with Microsoft Graph.
description: A production integration platform that moves Dynamics 365 email workflows off legacy Exchange Web Services (EWS) onto Microsoft Graph, including large attachment handling, draft management and synchronisation.

title: Darwin
tagline: Long-term research into distributed, collaborative AI.
description: A long-term research project exploring distributed AI systems, decentralised compute and storage, and large-scale collaborative intelligence architectures. It is also where darwinlabs.org gets its name.

title: Watson
tagline: This very assistant you're talking to.
description: Bhavya's portfolio agent: FastAPI backend, vector retrieval over his portfolio content, a budget-aware model router that falls back from OpenAI to Gemini to Groq, session transcripts by email, and a React frontend with in-chat cards.
highlights: RAG over portfolio content with ChromaDB
Structured replies with in-chat cards and suggestions
Admin dashboard with sessions and request logs
